services.name: Galveston Yacht Marina
services.desc: Boating can be a fun activity for you and your whole family. Whether you’re taking the boat out for a leisurely cruise, embarking on a deep-sea fishing trip, or taking the family tubing out on a lake, having a boat can open the door to all sorts of fun activities for you and your family. However, with a boat comes the issue of boat storage. Where do you park your boat when it’s not in use? That’s where a marina comes in! Marinas offer boat slips for lease, which are basically storage for boats.
